title: ac new and at new store any string as a criterion or test label
body:
Found by ST0095's close-time comparison of the start and close Highlander sweeps (vc, 2026-11-22, start cluster C9, missed by the close sweep). Fixed under hv decision 86.

`intent ac new` and `intent at new` (Facade::ac_new, at_new, and the put path) accept any string as a criterion or test label. Nothing on the create path asks the waist whether it is a label, so a malformed label is stored, and the readers that do check (group_of, the gate) then disagree about it.

Expected: the create path reads the label through the waist's one label reader and refuses a malformed one with a remedy naming the label form, writing nothing.
